description: Get a best-execution swap quote on Base. Compares Uniswap V3, PancakeSwap V3 and Aerodrome (plus two-hop routes via WETH), returns the winning venue, expected output, edge in bps vs the baseline, a liquidity flag (deep/watch/thin), the exact block number and timestamp, and build latency. Read-only: no funds move.

amountIn.description: Human-readable input amount, e.g. "10" for 10 USDC

tokenIn.description: Input token contract address on Base (e.g. USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA4E46E)

tokenOut.description: Output token contract address on Base (e.g. WETH 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006)

name: flow_quote
